description: Shell script for testing 'git diff --relative' functionality, including setup, various diff checks, and unmerged diff tests.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Checks git diff with -p option and compares actual output to expected.

methods.name: check_numstat
methods.description: Checks git diff --numstat output against expected.

methods.name: check_stat
methods.description: Checks git diff --stat output against expected.

methods.name: check_raw
methods.description: Checks git diff --raw output against expected.

methods.name: check_diff_relative_option
methods.description: Tests diff with specific --relative option and compares output.

methods.name: check_diff_no_relative_option
methods.description: Tests diff with --no-relative option and compares output.
